title: Open a sev2 incident
goal: Stand up an incident channel and a tracking issue the way our SRE team does it
context: Recorded during the payments incident; the narration carries two team conventions the clicks alone do not show.

params.name: incident_slug
params.description: Short identifier for this incident, used in the channel name
params.rationale: Names this particular incident; every run is a different incident.

params.name: summary
params.description: One-line description of what is wrong
params.rationale: Describes the specific failure being responded to.

params.name: severity
params.rationale: The narration ties priority to severity, so severity must be an input rather than fixed at sev2.

steps.title: Create the incident channel
steps.intent: One place for the bridge to coordinate

args.name: name
args.rationale: The channel is named for the incident.

steps.title: Make the channel private
steps.intent: Narration: "Always make the incident channel private first"

args.name: visibility
args.rationale: A team convention, not a per-incident choice. Stated in the narration as 'always'.

steps.title: Set the channel topic
steps.intent: So anyone joining sees the severity immediately

steps.title: Create the tracking issue
steps.intent: Every incident gets an issue for the post-mortem trail

args.name: project
args.rationale: Incidents always go on the INC board; a different board would be a different workflow.

steps.title: Set the issue priority from the severity
steps.intent: Narration: "Priority is highest for a sev2"

args.name: value
args.rationale: Derived from severity rather than chosen freely; the condition carries the rule.

outcomes.describe: the incident channel exists and is private
an INC tracking issue exists at the right priority
